rulings.item: Empty-main dynamic start: +4,932 user instructions (832,290 -> 837,222, +0.6%; kernel -3,482, faults 62 -> 61). The cost is per program header: libniji's start spends about 2.4k user instructions per header of the program (dummy-note probe: 13 headers 832,383, 14 headers 834,805, 15 headers 837,253), and the required property note adds PT_NOTE + PT_GNU_PROPERTY; every program with text after the old group end gains (3 libraries -7,996 user, -20,041 kernel, -2 faults)
rulings.recommendation: accept, with a follow-up story making libniji's start cost independent of the program's header count (it would also cut the cost of every program's existing headers)

informational: libniji's start (loader or libc) costs about 2.4k user instructions per program header of the program (Zen 1, medians of 101 runs, ~/work/crt-start-files/m0probe3.sh on keke); glibc-built programs carry the same headers
Static programs keep two R E LOADs (before and after): crti's .init, then libc.a's hot text group at a 64 KiB boundary more than a page later; libc.a layout, not the start files

Static relro anchor moved from .data.rel.ro.local to an empty .preinit_array: in libc.a the former followed a program's own relro and padded it by up to 60 KiB; padded non-PIE static probe showed 2 RW LOADs (no test bounds it; not compared with the pre-story crt1)
cargo xtask plants refuses .S plants outside a niji_machine_<fn>: label, so _start, the anchor stub and crti.S cannot be planted; the source-assembly unit test covers them
